This confirms commit 3fccc0e7c doesn't touch the relevant loop — only unrelated changes. So the loop remained unchanged from 1f1b51617 until the fix in df2beb076.

## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: 1f1b516171664d26669bc59009aefd81aaa76a17

## Reasoning

**(1) Investigation:** The fix commit (df2beb076) modifies a loop in `StudentSectioningDatabaseLoader.java` that calls `section.setName(course.getUniqueId(), c.getClassSuffix(course))` for each `CourseOffering` of an instructional offering. The fix wraps this call with a null check on the suffix. I used `git log -S"c.getClassSuffix(course)"` (pickaxe search) to find the commit that introduced this exact code, which located commit `1f1b51617` ("Tue Jun 20 09:57:38 2017 +0200"). I then verified with `git show` that this commit added the entire loop (`for (CourseOffering course: io.getCourseOfferings()) section.setName(course.getUniqueId(), c.getClassSuffix(course));`) as brand-new code — there was no prior null-safety around the suffix. I further checked all commits touching the file between `1f1b51617` and the bug-fix commit (`df2beb076`) and confirmed the only intervening commit (`3fccc0e7c`) made unrelated changes (adding a `iShowConfigName` flag and updating logging calls), never touching this loop.

**(2) The specific defect:** Commit `1f1b51617` introduced a call to `Section.setName(Long, String)` using the return value of `Class_.getClassSuffix(CourseOffering)` without checking whether it could be `null`. Looking at `Class_.getClassSuffix(CourseOffering)` (JavaSource/org/unitime/timetable/model/Class_.java:1672), it delegates to `getExternalClassNameHelper().getClassSuffix(this, courseOffering)`, whose default/pluggable implementations can legitimately return `null` (e.g., when there's no suffix set for a given course offering). Passing that `null` into `section.setName(...)` created bad/invalid entries in the section's name map, which the later fix avoids by skipping the `setName` call entirely when `suffix == null`.

**(3) Supporting evidence:**
- `git show 1f1b51617` shows this exact loop being added fresh (all lines are `+`), with no prior null-guard.
- `git log --oneline 1f1b51617..df2beb076 -- .../StudentSectioningDatabaseLoader.java` shows only one intervening commit, which is unrelated to this code path — confirming the buggy code was unchanged from `1f1b51617` through to the fix.
- The fix's semantics (add `if (suffix != null)` before calling `setName`) directly match a scenario where `getClassSuffix(course)` can return `null`, which is exactly what `1f1b51617` introduced without a null check.

I'm confident in this identification — the pickaxe search directly located the single commit that introduced the exact unguarded call replaced in the fix, and no other commit modified this loop in between.
